dimensions.assessment: Directly affects personnel and administrative operations within the Department of Homeland Security.
dimensions.evidence: transfer the program currently known as the 'Special Events Program' of the Department of Homeland Security to the Office of Situational Awareness

dimensions.assessment: An internal administrative transfer of functions, personnel, assets, and funds within a federal department.
dimensions.evidence: all functions, personnel, assets, records, and unexpended balances of appropriations... shall accompany such transfer.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers existing unexpended balances of appropriations but authorizes no new spending.
dimensions.evidence: unexpended balances of appropriations, authorizations, allocations, or other funds... shall accompany such transfer.

dimensions.assessment: Applies strictly to internal organizational alignment within the Department of Homeland Security.
dimensions.evidence: To transfer the Special Events Program of the Department of Homeland Security to the Office of Situational Awareness of the Department

dimensions.assessment: A one-time administrative transfer required within 180 days of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act... the Secretary of Homeland Security shall transfer
